High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the second application under Section 483 of BNSS/ 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.94/2024 registered at Police Station Dindori, District Dindori (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 366, 376 of IPC and Section 5/L/6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(w)(II), 3(1)(v) of SC/ST Act.
The applicant is in custody since 17.03.2024.
Previous bail application was dismissed as withdrawn.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against present applicant is that he has taken away the prosecutrix and committed rape upon her.
On the basis of which, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 17.03.2024.
In the statement recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. and even in Court Statement, prosecutrix has not deposed against the applicant.
She has stated that her parents had beaten her therefore she herself left her home.
She has not NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:22029 2 MCRC-17542-2025 supported the prosecution story.
Charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of the trial will take considerable time

,
therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
